spanish: Todo abridor de matriz a mí, y todo tu ganado será macho, abridor de buey y oveja o cabra.
grammarChanges: Restored תִּזָּכָר (Niphal imperfect 3fs) as a finite verb, será, instead of the bare attributive adjective macho, to keep its stem, person, and imperfect force.
Widened שֶׂה from cordero (young sheep) to oveja o cabra, matching its common-gender, one-of-a-flock sense (sheep or goat) instead of narrowing it to a young sheep.
readerNote: Chose será macho (finite future) to carry תִּזָּכָר's Niphal imperfect 3fs force, and oveja o cabra to keep שֶׂה's common-gender flock sense instead of narrowing to a lamb.
